topic: Apple internally tested an Apple Pencil for the foldable iPhone Ultra — stubbier than the iPad version, magnetic side-attach — but Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports it likely won't launch at the September 9 event
details: Single-source Bloomberg (Gurman, Power On newsletter, Aug 30 2026) scoop, echoed by 9to5Mac, MacRumors, Forbes, iPhoneinCanada. Two reasons given for shelving it: (1) parking it on the long edge makes the foldable awkward to hold and to open — you'd have to peel it off to unfold; (2) the pointed tip risks marking the delicate internal foldable display, which would undercut the ultra-premium pitch. Historical irony: Steve Jobs mocked styluses in 2007 ('who wants a stylus'). iPhone Ultra name and Sept 9 event date are themselves still not 100% confirmed as the foldable's reveal, though the event itself is officially confirmed (established in apple-surprise-and-shine).
